items.reason: Needs network: pinning a tag to a digest means asking GitHub what that tag points at now, and `npm run actions:pin -- --update` (which also flips STRICT/RATCHET so the pins are enforced) is already written and waiting for one networked run.

The narrating subjects are already on master and cannot be reworded without git history rewriting; A5 blocks on every path the repository controls, and the uncovered path is an automation lane that commits in a hookless worktree, so I strengthened the guidance that lane's agent reads instead (a committed .husky/commit-msg was refused as a sensitive file).

Needs a build run: a budget that fails has to be seeded from measured numbers (first-load JS per route, or a Playwright timing), and with no shell every threshold I could write would be either invented or vacuous.

Added a weekly real-model prove of every registered operation against the configured provider, failing the run on drift and publishing a dated pass/fail trail to a GitHub issue; it stays on the reporting rung and a unit test fails if it is deleted, un-scheduled, or pulled into check:ci.

Already covered in the tree: docs/deploy.md has a Rollback section and docs/runbooks/revert-drill.md is a full seeded-fault drill routed from docs/task-index.md; what is missing is a recorded row (a timed drill), which needs somebody to run deploys and git and is deliberately not promoted to a gate until two rows exist.

Every check:ci gate now prints the exact next command from one table (scripts/gate-remedy.mjs) on its own failure path, `npm run gates` shows the whole chain, the chain was reordered so eleven zero-dependency checks run before `next build`, and test-unit/gate-remedy.test.mjs fails when a stage has no entry, a remedy names a script that does not exist, or a gate stops printing its remedy.

lessons: This repository already answers most maturity gaps somewhere in the tree — docs/task-index.md routes task to document, and checking it first turns two of six items into 'already covered, here is the residual' instead of duplicate machinery.

Its own rung discipline (docs/adr/0007) forbids landing a check that does not pass today, so a gate needing a measured baseline (a perf budget, a drill-recency check) cannot honestly be added by a session with no shell — the honest output is a skip naming the one command a human must run.

Enforcement here is designed around the fact that automation lanes commit in throwaway worktrees where no git hook is installed: rules that must bite live in check:ci and in a workflow, never in a hook alone.
